starts.definedText: QA Outreach has a definition, and this seat's schedules come from it. To change or remove one, change the seat's start in the definition's folder, import it on the Definition tab, and publish it.
starts.heading: How it starts

confirmLines: Every later talk and every later run of Boss will be given this text.
A text you have changed is saved as a new version first, and that version is published.
It replaces version 1, which is kept. History can bring it back.
This brief is part of the definition of QA Outreach. Its versions are the definition's versions, and a publish publishes the whole definition - every seat, start and file in it - not only this brief.
It also puts live the other change saved in the definition since version 1 was published, not only this brief: Seat Author (writer) changed: name Writer -> Author.
'QA Undefined scout at noon' stops being a schedule of Scout. The sessions it starts no longer belong to QA Undefined.
It stays switched on and keeps running at its times, as a plain schedule in no factory. Pause it first if it should stop.
It is kept, not deleted. It is listed on the Schedule page, and cc-devthrottle schedule link puts it back on a seat.
Scout will then be talk only.
unlink.label: Take off this seat

38-defined-seats-tab.definedText: QA Outreach has a definition, and its seats' schedules come from it, so none is edited here. To change or remove one, change the seat's start in the definition's folder, import it on the Definition tab, and publish it.

confirmLines: A copy of version 1 becomes version 4, and it is published. Every later talk and every later run of Boss will be given that text.
No version is removed: version 3, which is published now, and every other version are kept.
This brief is part of the definition of QA Outreach. Its versions are the definition's versions, and a publish publishes the whole definition - every seat, start and file in it - not only this brief.
It also brings back the rest of definition version 1, not only this brief, and so makes this other change to version 3, the published one: Seat Writer (writer) changed: name Author -> Writer.
